scripts.//ng: Pass-through to the Angular CLI (e.g. npm run ng -- generate …).
scripts.//start: Serve the web app locally with the development configuration.
scripts.//start:external: Serve on all interfaces so a phone on the same Wi‑Fi can hit this Mac’s IP.
scripts.//watch: Rebuild the web app on file changes (development configuration).
scripts.//build:dev: One-shot development web build into www/ (unminified, source maps).
scripts.//build:prod: One-shot production web build into www/ (optimized; used for store releases).
scripts.//sync: Copy www/ into both native projects and update Capacitor plugins/pods.
scripts.//sync:ios: Copy www/ into the iOS project only.
scripts.//sync:android: Copy www/ into the Android project only.
scripts.//ios: Dev web build + sync iOS, then open Xcode for day-to-day native work.
scripts.ios: npm run build:dev && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.//android: Dev web build + sync Android, then open Android Studio (Temurin JDK wrapper).
scripts.android: npm run build:dev && npx cap sync android && bash scripts/android-with-jdk.sh npx cap open android
scripts.//ios:run: Dev web build + sync, then run on the iOS Simulator / selected device.
scripts.ios:run: npm run build:dev && npx cap sync ios && npx cap run ios
scripts.//android:run: Dev web build + sync, then run on an Android emulator / device.
scripts.android:run: npm run build:dev && npx cap sync android && bash scripts/android-with-jdk.sh npx cap run android
scripts.//ios:live: Live-reload the iOS app against ng serve on localhost:4200 (dev only).
scripts.//android:live: Live-reload the Android app against ng serve on localhost:4200 (dev only).
scripts.android:live: bash scripts/android-with-jdk.sh npx cap run android -l --host=localhost --port=4200 --forwardPorts=4200:4200
scripts.//ios:live:device: Live-reload on a physical iPhone (see scripts/ios-live-device.mjs).
scripts.//build:ios:release: Production www/ + Cap sync iOS. Run before Archive / TestFlight.
scripts.build:ios:release: ng build --configuration production && npx cap sync ios
scripts.//ios:release: Production build + sync, then open Xcode so you can Product → Archive for TestFlight/App Store.
scripts.ios:release: npm run build:ios:release && npx cap open ios
scripts.//build:android:release: Production www/ + Cap sync Android. Run before a Play AAB.
scripts.build:android:release: ng build --configuration production && npx cap sync android
scripts.//android:release: Production build + sync, then open Android Studio (optional; CLI AAB uses android:bundle).
scripts.android:release: npm run build:android:release && bash scripts/android-with-jdk.sh npx cap open android
scripts.//android:bundle: Production build + sync, then Gradle bundleRelease → Play upload AAB (bump versionCode first).
scripts.android:bundle: npm run build:android:release && bash scripts/android-with-jdk.sh ./android/gradlew -p android bundleRelease && node -e "console.log('AAB: android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab'); console.log('R8 mapping (upload to Play): android/app/build/outputs/mapping/release/mapping.txt')"
scripts.//store:preflight: Checks before App Store / Play upload (no server.url, minify, versions, legal URLs).
scripts.//android:apk: Production APK for sideload (not accepted by Play for new apps).
scripts.android:apk: npm run build:android:release && bash scripts/android-with-jdk.sh ./android/gradlew -p android assembleRelease
scripts.//generate:icons: Regenerate app icons/splash from resources/ (restores portrait splash after).
